title: A 于 V (A to V)
longExplanation: A to V. Pinyin: A yú V

examples.sentence: 做决定，需要勇于承担责任。
examples.romanization: zuò juédìng， xūyào yǒngyú chéngdān zérèn。
examples.translation: To make a decision, you need to be courageous to take responsibility.

examples.sentence: 他的粗心致使试验失败。
examples.romanization: tā de cūxīn zhìshǐ shìyàn shībài。
examples.translation: His carelessness caused the test to fail.

examples.sentence: 类似小王这样的年轻人并非少数。
examples.romanization: lèisì xiǎo wáng zhèyàng de niánqīngrén bìngfēi shǎoshù。
examples.translation: Young people like Xiao Wang are not a minority.

title: 对 N 而言 (for N (see 4.05.4 “对……来说”))
longExplanation: for N (see 4.05.4 “对……来说”). Pinyin: duì N éryán

examples.sentence: 对今天的中国而言，经济发展必须坚持走可持续发展的道路。
examples.romanization: duì jīntiān de Zhōngguó éryán， jīngjìfāzhǎn bìxū jiānchí zǒu kěchíxùfāzhǎn de dàolù。
examples.translation: For today's China, economic development must adhere to the path of sustainable development.

examples.sentence: 他查阅了大量有关服饰问题的资料。
examples.romanization: tā cháyuè le dàliàng yǒuguān fúshì wèntí de zīliào。
examples.translation: He consulted a lot of information about clothing issues.

title: 和 N 有关 (related to N)
longExplanation: related to N. Pinyin: hé N yǒuguān

examples.sentence: 中国的语文教学向来重视识字，这固然和汉字的特点有关。
examples.romanization: Zhōngguó de yǔwén jiàoxué xiànglái zhòngshì shízì， zhè gùrán hé hànzì de tèdiǎn yǒuguān。
examples.translation: Chinese language teaching has always attached importance to literacy, which is of course related to the characteristics of Chinese characters.

title: 不瞒你说 (actually)
longExplanation: actually. Pinyin: bù mán nǐ shuō

examples.sentence: 不瞒你说，对这个问题，我是这样想的。
examples.romanization: bù mán nǐ shuō， duì zhège wèntí， wǒ shì zhèyàng xiǎng de。
examples.translation: To tell you the truth, regarding this question, this is what I think.

title: 说真的/说实在的 (indeed, truthfully)
longExplanation: indeed, truthfully. Pinyin: shuō zhēn de/ shuō shízài de
formation: shuō zhēn de/ shuō shízài de

examples.sentence: 说真的，这次真是孩子给我上了一课。
examples.romanization: shuō zhēn de， zhè cì zhēnshi háizi gěi wǒ shàng le yī kè。
examples.translation: Seriously, this time the child really gave me a lesson.

title: 通红、雪白 (very red, very white)
longExplanation: very red, very white. Pinyin: tōnghóng、 xuěbái

examples.translation: My face is red from suffocation.

title: 说 V/A 就 V/A (V without thinking, be A without thinking)
shortExplanation: V without thinking, be A without thinking
longExplanation: V without thinking, be A without thinking. Pinyin: shuō V/A jiù V/A

examples.sentence: 挺好的工作，怎么说不干就不干了？
examples.romanization: tǐnghǎo de gōngzuò， zěnme shuō bù gàn jiù bù gàn le？
examples.translation: Very good job, how come you quit just like that (without thinking)?

title: V/A 得要命 (V so much one could die, so A one could die)
shortExplanation: V so much one could die, so A one could die
longExplanation: V so much one could die, so A one could die. Pinyin: V/A dé yàomìng

examples.sentence: 五个小时没碰手机，我空虚得要命。
examples.romanization: wǔ gè xiǎoshí méi pèng shǒujī， wǒ kōngxū dé yàomìng。
examples.translation: I didn't touch my cell phone for five hours, and I feel so empty [from not having anythnig to do] I could die.

title: 以至 (于) (as a result)
longExplanation: as a result. Pinyin: yǐzhì ( yú)

examples.sentence: 中国的饮食文化汲收不同国家的优异之处，以至于辉煌至今。
examples.romanization: Zhōngguó de yǐnshí wénhuà jí shōu bùtóng guójiā de yōuyì zhī chǔ， yǐzhìyú huīhuáng zhìjīn。
examples.translation: China's food culture has absorbed the excellence of different countries, [and] as a result its brilliance [has shone] to this day.

examples.sentence: 她最近心情不好，即便有些不讲理，你也要原谅她。
examples.romanization: tā zuìjìn xīnqíng bùhǎo， jíbiàn yǒuxiē bù jiǎnglǐ， nǐ yě yào yuánliàng tā。
examples.translation: She has a bad mood recently. Even if she is a little unreasonable, you still have to forgive her.

examples.sentence: 培养人是教育的立足点，是教育价值的根本所在，是教育的本体功能。
examples.romanization: péiyǎng rén shì jiàoyù de lìzúdiǎn， shì jiàoyù jiàzhí de gēnběn suǒzài， shì jiàoyù de běntǐ gōngnéng。
examples.translation: Cultivating people is the foothold of education, is where the foundation of education’s value lies, and the ontological function of education.

examples.sentence: 他选择了风景秀美、气候宜人的所在。
examples.romanization: tā xuǎnzé le fēngjǐng xiùměi、 qìhòu yírén de suǒzài。
examples.translation: He chose a place with beautiful scenery and a pleasant climate.
